title: File System Watcher
requirements: Implement FileSystemWatcher observing the Diary output folder
Post insert/update/delete notifications to DiaryStore or consuming view-model
Debounce rapid burst changes to avoid duplicate refreshes
acceptance_criteria: New .m4a file appears in timeline within 2 seconds of creation
External file deletion removes entry from timeline within 2 seconds
Burst writes (10 files in 1 second) result in at most 2 refresh events
